The '''2010–11 East Tennessee State Buccaneers men's basketball team''' represented [[East Tennessee State University]] in the [[2010–11 NCAA Division I men's basketball season]]. The Buccaneers, led by head coach [[Murry Bartow]], played their home games at [[ETSU/Mountain States Health Alliance Athletic Center]] in [[Johnson City, Tennessee]], as members of the [[Atlantic Sun Conference]]. The Buccaneers finished 2nd in the Atlantic Sun during the regular season, but lost in the second round of the [[2011 Atlantic Sun men's basketball tournament|Atlantic Sun tournament]] after being upset by sixth-seeded {{cbb link|year=2010|team=North Florida Ospreys|title=North Florida}}.<ref>{{cite web |title=North Florida 59, ETSU 55 |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/310632193 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230117202434/https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/310632193 |url-status=dead |archive-date=January 17, 2023 |publisher=[[ESPN]] |date=March 4, 2011 |access-date=January 17, 2023}}</ref>

East Tennessee State failed to qualify for the [[2011 NCAA Division I men's basketball tournament|NCAA tournament]], but were invited to the [[2011 CollegeInsider.com Postseason Tournament|2011 CIT]]. The Buccaneers advanced to the semifinals of the CIT, where they were eliminated by [[2010–11 Iona Gaels men's basketball team|Iona]], 85–74.<ref>{{cite web |title=Mike Glover's 33 points leads Iona past ETSU into CIT finals |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/310852193 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20230117202437/https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/recap/_/gameId/310852193 |url-status=dead |archive-date=January 17, 2023 |publisher=[[ESPN]] |date=March 26, 2011 |access-date=January 17, 2023}}</ref>
